dialogue.intro: Hey, new face! Important question: are you wearing shoes you can run in? I've got a treasure map and a completely irresponsible amount of enthusiasm.
dialogue.repeat: There you are! I was deciding between a scavenger hunt, a snack contest, and sitting dramatically by the river. You're invited to all three.
talk: Today's mission: find a card with an attack name that sounds like a terrible pickup line. Winner gets bragging rights.
Everyone asks why I'm in a bikini. Nobody asks why they're in boring pants. We've been investigating the wrong mystery.
I can plan an entire street festival from memory. Ask me what I want to do when I'm sad and my brain goes completely blank.
I used to think 'no thanks' meant someone didn't like me. Turns out sometimes people are just tired. Revolutionary.
Yes, I can sit still. Watch. ...Okay, seven seconds. That counts as meditation.
I wore a jacket to the tournament. It was mesh. Jun called it 'a start.' He's getting sentimental.
dialogue.flirt: Careful! I flirt back. But only if it's fun for both of us. Want to find out?
dialogue.duelWin: You beat me! Okay, you choose the victory snack. I'm only pretending not to be impressed.
dialogue.duelLose: Ha! My ridiculous combo worked! You owe me a rematch, and I owe you a drink.
hangouts: Sol drags you through a five-stop waterfront scavenger hunt. The prize is a hand-drawn trophy on a napkin. She keeps the napkin.
You join her 'worst card-name pickup line' contest at the arcade. A shy beginner wins; Sol applauds the loudest.
You two test hilariously strange fruit-juice combinations at the café. She declares the purple one a marketing opportunity.
Sol packs a spontaneous sunset picnic, and—for once—does not schedule a single activity. She admits the silence is nice.
You help Sol run a deck-box fashion show and invite a nervous newcomer to judge. They decide that everybody wins.

appearance.silhouette: Unambiguously adult, confident and curvy-athletic; a striking bikini-and-resort-streetwear silhouette in every setting, paired with lightweight coverups or practical layers where appropriate.
appearance.palette: Lagoon turquoise, vivid coral pink, sunflower yellow and midnight navy accessories.
appearance.hair: Very long, lively coral-pink waves with golden highlights, frequently in a high messy ponytail.
appearance.eyes: Expressive sea-green eyes, sun freckles and naturally lively smile lines.
appearance.details: Shell-and-sun earrings, stacked colorful bangles, waterproof deck case on a crossbody strap, playful enamel badges, practical sandals and spare dry cardigan.
appearance.expressions: Huge daring grin, theatrical wink, mock shock, exuberant closed-eye laugh, unguarded worried stare, relieved soft smile when she realizes she can be quiet with someone.
outfits: signature asymmetric turquoise/coral bikini with airy mesh layer and open tropical shirt
neon-magenta bikini with long open navy cardigan at evening events
swim top under oversized orange varsity shirt and denim shorts at arcade
raincoat over her trademark swimsuit on wet days
neat sleeveless coverup and shorts over bikini at tournament venues
appearance.renderNotes: SFW anime/JRPG romantic-comedy character, age 26; flirty and bold without nudity, lingerie framing or sexualized poses. Match the expressive, stylized proportions and clean full-color portrait style of Neo Harbor's adult cast.
